                =\sum_{m=1}^{\infty}10^{-km},
\]

\[

   =\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\tau(n)\,10^{-n},
\]

where \(\tau(n)\) is the number of positive divisors of \(n\).

\[
10^{100}S =\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\tau(n)\,10^{100-n}
          =\underbrace{\sum_{n=1}^{100}\tau(n)10^{100-n}}_{\text{integer part}}

\]

\[

\]
